question.text: Which AI lab will have the top-scoring model on the Arena "Creative Writing" leaderboard on December 1, 2026?
question.resolution_criteria: This question resolves as the lab with the highest Model Score at the Arena creative writing [leaderboard](https://arena.ai/leaderboard/chat/text/creative-writing?rankBy=labs) when checked by Metaculus on or after December 1, 2026.
question.fine_print:
A lab other than the ones listed (for example, Alibaba) resolves as **Other**.

In case of a tie for first, the tiebreaker is the lab with the higher model rank. 

In case of accessibility issues with the main resolution source, the question may resolve from a Wayback Machine snapshot of the page closest in time to noon UTC at the forecast's target date. It may also resolve based on the "creative_writing" category of the official Arena leaderboard dataset (https://huggingface.co/datasets/lmarena-ai/leaderboard-dataset) or from a Wayback Machine snapshot thereof.

# Arena Creative Writing leaderboard: research for the December 1, 2026 question

**Summary:** Anthropic is in first place, but only just. Claude Opus 5.5 scores 1520 and Google's Gemini 4 Argon scores 1517, a gap well inside the ±13 confidence intervals. Nothing settles the question yet.

## 1. Resolution source
- 2026-10-27 (date shown as "last updated" when I fetched it on 2026-11-06): the lab rankings on the Arena Creative Writing page are:
  1. Anthropic, Claude Opus 5.5 (High): 1520 ±13
  2. Google, Gemini 4 Argon (High): 1517 ±13
  3. Meta, Muse Wonder (Max): 1487 ±15
  4. OpenAI, GPT-5.6 Sol (xHigh): 1470 ±7
  5. Alibaba, Qwen3.8-Max: 1469
  6. SpaceXAI (xAI's Grok), Grok 4.20 Beta 1: 1463

  [Arena](https://arena.ai/leaderboard/chat/text/creative-writing?rankBy=labs)
- 2026-11-06: a mirror site shows the same top three models: Opus 5.5 at 1520, Gemini 4 Argon at 1517, and Gemini 4 Carbon (High) at 1515. Carbon is already rated in this category, about 5 points behind Opus. Next are Claude Fable 5 (1501), Opus 4.6 (1499) and Claude Fable 5.1 (1489). [benchleader](https://www.benchleader.com/benchmarks/lmarena_text_creative)
- I did not check the Hugging Face dataset that serves as the backup source.

## 2. Current status
- Nothing has settled the question. Anthropic leads by 3 points over Google, and Google's three models sit within 5 points of the top. A routine leaderboard update could flip first place.
- Meta, OpenAI and xAI are 33 to 57 points behind. Catching up would take a new model release.

## 3. Recent news (newest first)
- 2026-11-05: OpenAI launched GPT-6 Cyber, a specialist security model. It is probably not relevant to creative writing. [DEV](https://dev.to/hiroki-ii-ai/ai-daily-digest-november-6-2026-openai-ships-gpt-6-cyber-meta-buys-conductor-anthropic-locks-1jij)
- About 2026-11-02: an unconfirmed social media post lists rumored release windows: GPT-6.2 Astra (Nov 2-15), GPT-6.2 Sol (Nov 10-15), Grok 4.8 (November), Claude Fable 5.5 (around Nov 30), and Claude Opus 5.6 (late Nov or December). I saw these only in a search summary because the post itself was paywalled. [X/mark_k](https://x.com/mark_k/status/2117323044213625181)
- 2026-10-28: Google released Gemini 4 Carbon about two weeks after Argon. So far only cybersecurity experts and trusted partners can use it, with wider access to come. [The Decoder](https://the-decoder.com/google-deepmind-releases-gemini-4-carbon-just-two-weeks-after-argon-with-gains-across-the-board/)
- Late Oct 2026: Arena said Gemini 4 Carbon debuted at #1 in Text Arena overall, reportedly scoring 1528 against Argon's 1520. In creative writing it ranks only #3. [Arena on X](https://x.com/arena/status/2115495002998751262), [Latent Space](https://latent.space/p/ainews-gemini-4-carbon/)
- 2026-09-26: Opus 5.5 reached #1 in creative writing, at first on limited votes. [tutkit](https://www.tutkit.com/en/blog/846-claude-opus-55-leads-arena-rankings-for-creative-writing)

## 4. Base rates
- Anthropic has led this category for most of 2026:
  - June: Claude Opus 4.6 thinking [OfficeChai](https://officechai.com/learn/these-are-the-best-ai-models-for-creative-writing-june-2026/)
  - July 20: Claude Fable 5, about 1513
  - Late August: Fable 5.1 or Opus 5.5 reported as #1, though sources conflict
  - Since late September: Opus 5.5 [search summary/modelmenu](https://modelmenu.dev/best/writing/arena-text-creative-writing)
- Opus 5.5's score has moved between snapshots: 1534 on Oct 15 and Oct 22 according to modelmenu, against 1519 to 1520 on other snapshots. Scores can shift by up to about 15 points within weeks, which is far more than the current 3-point gap.
- Anthropic models fill 4 of the top 8 spots, so if new Google votes push Opus 5.5 down, Anthropic has no backup model close behind. Google has three models within 5 points of first place.
- Over 2026, Google models have tended to lead the overall Text Arena while Anthropic led creative writing.

## 5. Other forecasts
- I found no market on this exact question, the creative writing leader on Dec 1.
- Kalshi, overall top Text Arena model on Nov 30: Gemini 4 Carbon (High) at 76%, Gemini 4 Argon at 4%, Claude Opus 5.5 at 2%. This shows Google is strong overall, but it is a different category.
- Polymarket, "next Fable model (5.2+) debuts #1 in Text Arena": 55% Yes (resolves by 2027-07). The market still expects a Claude Fable release, but that does not have to happen before Dec 1.
- Polymarket, "GPT Astra 6.1+ debuts #1 in Text Arena": 2%.
- Kalshi, "Which companies will have a top-ranked AI model this year?": OpenAI 10%, Meta 10%, xAI 6%.
- Manifold, Thinking Machines tops Chatbot Arena by end of 2026: 2%.

## 6. Upcoming events before Dec 1
- Wider release of Gemini 4 Carbon would bring more votes and could move its creative writing score (now 1515) in either direction.
- Rumored releases, all unconfirmed:
  - OpenAI: GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol in mid-November
  - xAI: Grok 4.8
  - Anthropic: Claude Fable 5.5 around Nov 30 and Opus 5.6 in late November or December
- A new Anthropic model added right before Dec 1 might appear first with wide, preliminary confidence intervals.
- Routine Arena score updates, roughly weekly, could swap Anthropic and Google given how close they are.
- I could not confirm any official release dates.

forecasts.reasoning:
(a) **Time left:** About 25 days. The page is checked on or after December 1, 2026, so several weekly Arena updates and possibly new model releases will happen before then.

(b) **Status quo:** Anthropic wins. Claude Opus 5.5 leads at 1520, against Gemini 4 Argon at 1517 and Gemini 4 Carbon at 1515, as of the October 27 update.

(c) **Base rates:**
- Anthropic has led the creative writing category for most of 2026, from June through November, with Opus 4.6, Fable 5, Fable 5.1 and Opus 5.5.
- Google has generally led overall Text Arena but not creative writing.
- Over a single month, the leader usually stays the same, maybe 65-75% of the time. A 3-point gap is much more fragile than usual, though.

(d) **Strongest evidence:**
- Oct 27 / Nov 6 snapshots: Anthropic leads by only 3 points, and the confidence intervals are ±13. Earlier snapshots varied by about 15 points (1534 vs 1520).
- Google has two models within 5 points of the lead. Gemini 4 Carbon (Oct 28) is still in limited release, and wider access will bring many new votes. Carbon debuted #1 overall, and Kalshi gives Carbon 76% to be overall #1 on Nov 30, which shows strong momentum.
- Anthropic's possible new releases (Fable 5.5 around Nov 30, Opus 5.6 late Nov or December) are rumored and unconfirmed. Anthropic models have historically debuted strongly in creative writing.
- OpenAI's rumored GPT-6.2 Astra/Sol releases could compete. The market for GPT Astra debuting at #1 overall is only 2%, and OpenAI is 50 points behind in this category.
- Meta's Muse Wonder is 33 points behind.

(e) **Unexpected scenario:** OpenAI releases GPT-6.2 Sol in mid-November with a big jump in creative writing quality and debuts at the top of creative writing. Alternatively, Google ships a Gemini 4 Carbon update that pulls ahead by 10 or more points.

**Reasoning:** I start from the status quo (Anthropic) at around 65%. I move down because the gap is tiny, Google has several models close behind, and Carbon will collect more votes once it is widely available. I move partly back up because Anthropic has led this category consistently and may release a new model. That leaves Anthropic slightly ahead, but close to a coin flip.

A reasonable starting point is about 60 to 65% that the incumbent holds when nothing else is known.

- 2026-10-27 (labs view): Anthropic 1520 ±13 against Google 1517 ±13. The gap is statistically meaningless.

- Google has two models within 5 points, giving two chances for vote noise to flip the order.
